about: Recorded observations from the real SSAS 2025 tabular mirror on the VM, replayed against a running proxy by scripts/probe-parity.sh. Add a case whenever a review or VM session finds a proxy/reference difference, and record the MIRROR's value, not the proxy's. {catalog} and {cube} are substituted from the fields below, so the same case can be replayed against the mirror.

cases.source: SSAS 2025 tabular, MallardDemo/Model, 2026-09-24: without NON EMPTY the mirror returns all 4019 members (All + 4018 dates)
cases.known_gap: the reference does not prune date members when the axis has no NON EMPTY (measured 2026-09-26: 4,019 members with and without it); the proxy prunes to the fact-covered dates (2,459). The Excel path always sends NON EMPTY and is unaffected; the fix is to render a non-NON-EMPTY drilldown axis from the member dictionary with empty cells for the dates that have no facts
